description: The line plot, titled "ReDial," illustrates the performance of different models in terms of Recall@50 and NDCG@50 across five evaluation points, labeled 1 through 5 on the x-axis. The left y-axis, labeled "Recall@50," ranges from 0.30 to 0.60, while the right y-axis, labeled "NDCG@50," ranges from 0.15 to 0.22. The green solid line with circular markers represents "Recall@50 (Ours)," which starts at a value of approximately 0.35 at x=1 and shows a steady increase, reaching a value of about 0.49 at x=5. The blue solid line with square markers represents "NDCG@50 (Ours)," which begins at approximately 0.33 at x=1 and rises to about 0.46 at x=5. The green dotted line, corresponding to "NDCG@50 (Ours)," is a horizontal line at a value of approximately 0.19 across all x-values from 1 to 5. The blue dotted line, representing "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)," is also a horizontal line, maintaining a constant value of approximately 0.16 across the entire range of the x-axis.
